summary: ST3_WORKER_INTERVAL_MS, the existing test-only cap on worker timers, now also caps the 30 s catch-up projection interval and the 60 s divergence window, which stays twice the catch-up interval; unset, both are unchanged

replay.detail: No replay or projection change; with the variable unset the catch-up interval is 30 s and the divergence window 60 s, as before.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No rule, checkpoint or coordinated upgrade change; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: No wire, API or doc-version change. Production daemons do not set ST3_WORKER_INTERVAL_MS.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Nothing is persisted; swap back freely.
